text:
PRUDENTIAL BANKING BOARD FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Final rule: Operational resilience of important business services
Notice number: RCN-2026-003
Issued by: Prudential Banking Board
Published: 2026-08-18
Effective date: 2027-03-31
1. Who this applies to
Deposit-taking institutions with more than 1 billion in total assets.
2. Background
Disruptions to payments, card authorization and online banking can cause serious harm to customers. Firms are expected to plan on the basis that disruption will happen.
3. Requirements
3.1 A firm must identify its important business services and set an impact tolerance for the maximum tolerable disruption of each.
3.2 A firm must test its ability to remain within impact tolerance through severe but plausible scenario exercises at least once a year.
3.3 The board must approve the list of important business services and impact tolerances each year.
4. Status
Firms must comply with the requirements in section 3 from 2027-03-31.
